    cls.printers = cls.fc.fd[FLOW_NAMES.PRINTERS]
    cls.hpx_shortcuts = cls.fc.fd[FLOW_NAMES.HPX_SHORTCUTS]
    # Enable HPX Flag
    cls.fc.hpx = True
    logging.info("Starting Test Suite 04 for HPX Add Shortcuts")

def test_01_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_enables_only_the_save_destination_in_the_add_shortcut_screen(self):
        """
        Description: C70
        Steps:
            1.Install and Launch the HPX app.
            2.Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
            3.Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
            4.Click on the Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
            5.Then click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
            6.Enable only the 'Save' destination toggle bar in 'Add Shortcut' screen.
            7.Then click on the Continue button.
            8.Verify the screen.
        Expected Result:
            User should be navigated to the 'Add Save' screen.
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_save_toggle_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_continue_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_save_shortcut_title()

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Step Breakdown Rule for Complex Actions
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that involve multiple technical operations or state changes
rule_definition: WHEN: A manual test step implies multiple technical actions (e.g., Install and Launch app, Setup device connection)
THEN: Break down the step into sub-steps using suffix notation (1a, 1b, etc.) with clear execution order
IMPLEMENTATION: Create intermediary steps for each script line, maintain parent-child relationship using consistent ID format

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases requiring environmental prerequisites not explicitly stated
rule_definition: WHEN: Test execution requires system state setup not documented in manual steps (e.g., printer connection, user authentication)
THEN: Inject implicit setup steps with clear labeling before dependent test steps
IMPLEMENTATION: Insert steps labeled as 'Implicit Step' with step_type='implicit_setup' and include in intermediary breakdown

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Navigation actions and state-changing interactions
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step performs navigation or state change that requires confirmation before proceeding
THEN: Inject implicit verification step immediately after the action
IMPLEMENTATION: Add assert/verification step with step_type='implicit_verification' using naming pattern 'Implicit Step: Verify X'

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation steps in test cases
rule_definition: WHEN: Generating automation script from test case mapping
THEN: Assign strict sequential execution order using numeric sequence
IMPLEMENTATION: Order by step_type priority: setup < implicit_setup < action < implicit_verification < verification

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps involving toggle, switch, or checkbox interactions
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step involves enable/disable toggle or state-changing UI interaction
THEN: Always inject implicit verification step to confirm state change
IMPLEMENTATION: After toggle action, insert assert checking expected state with incremented execution order

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that perform screen navigation
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step performs navigation action (click leading to screen change)
THEN: Inject screen verification to ensure UI readiness for subsequent interactions

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Step Decomposition Rule for HPX Application Testing
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that map to multiple automation script lines requiring sequential execution
rule_definition: WHEN: A single test step corresponds to multiple automation script functions (indicated by → symbols in mapped_script_line)
THEN: The test step MUST be split into sub-steps labeled with alphabetic suffixes (1a, 1b, 1c, etc.)
IMPLEMENTATION: Each sub-step maps to exactly one script function and must execute in defined sequence with proper error handling and verification

automation_scripts_rules.description: Mandatory Implicit Step Inclusion Rule for Screen Navigation Verification
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases involving screen navigation and UI state changes in HPX application
rule_definition: WHEN: Any navigation action is performed (clicking buttons, navigating screens, changing UI state)
THEN: An implicit verification step MUST be added immediately after the navigation action
IMPLEMENTATION: Use verify_*_screen_title() or verify_*_screen_displayed() functions to confirm successful navigation before proceeding to next step

automation_scripts_rules.description: Application Reset and Initialization Pattern Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All HPX application test cases requiring clean starting state
rule_definition: WHEN: Beginning any HPX application test case
THEN: MUST start with application reset followed by home screen loading
IMPLEMENTATION: Step 1a: self.fc.reset_app() followed by Step 1b: self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False) with proper intermediary steps for state verification

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases requiring printer device connection and configuration
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case involves printer interaction or device setup
THEN: MUST follow the three-step printer setup pattern
IMPLEMENTATION: Step 2a: click_add_device_btn(), Step 2b: search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress), Step 2c: click_printer_device_card() with verification steps between each action

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases involving custom shortcut creation in HPX application
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case involves creating custom shortcuts through 'Create your own' workflow
THEN: MUST include all navigation steps with implicit verification steps
IMPLEMENTATION: Navigate to shortcuts → verify screen → click add new → verify screen → click create your own → verify screen → configure shortcut → navigate to save options → verify screen

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases verifying cloud account sign-in functionality and authentication workflows
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case involves cloud account sign-in verification (like Google Drive, OneDrive, etc.)
THEN: MUST include sign-in link click followed by authentication flow verification
IMPLEMENTATION: Use click_google_drive_signin_link() or equivalent cloud provider function, followed by verification of authentication screen display and proper context switching

automation_scripts_rules.description: Supporting Step Integration Rule for Test Case Purpose Validation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases of type 'Verify the screen, when user click on Sign in link of any cloud accounts under Add accounts in Add save screen'
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases that verify cloud account sign-in screen behavior
THEN: MUST include all implicit verification steps even if not explicitly mentioned in manual test steps

IMPLEMENTATION: Include verify_shortcuts_screen_title(), verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title(), verify_add_new_shortcut_title(), verify_add_save_shortcut_title() as these are required to fulfill the purpose of validating the complete user journey to the sign-in screen

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script implementations requiring strict step ordering
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing any test case with multiple steps and sub-steps
THEN: MUST execute all steps in exact sequential order without skipping or parallel execution
IMPLEMENTATION: Follow execution order from intermediary steps, ensure each step completes successfully before proceeding to next, implement proper error handling to halt execution on failure

automation_scripts_rules.description: Intermediary Step Documentation and Implementation Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script development requiring detailed step breakdown
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing automation scripts from test case mappings
THEN: MUST include all intermediary steps as defined in the intermediary_steps array
IMPLEMENTATION: Each intermediary step must be implemented with proper wait conditions, element verification, error handling, and state validation as specified in the steps array

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Future automation development using these rules and patterns
rule_definition: WHEN: Developing automation for similar test cases involving HPX app navigation, printer setup, shortcut creation, or cloud account authentication
THEN: MUST reference and apply the established patterns and rules from this rule set

IMPLEMENTATION: Use the correlation mappings, intermediary steps, and rule definitions as templates for similar test scenarios, ensuring consistency in automation approach and completeness of implementation
